collision_summary: The general PSW mechanism is not novel. Established work already covers persistent versions/structural sharing, guarded/faceted values, variational execution that shares similarities across configurations, and dependence-driven change propagation. The Frank-specific composition adds epistemic branch identity/provenance/epoch and authority constraints, but no world-first claim is supportable.

collisions.mechanism: execute alternatives together and share redundant work
recompute only where input differences matter

surviving_project_specific_elements: unresolved epistemic branch is explicitly not truth/authority
self.root + base epoch + branch revision + hypothesis + provenance identity separation
pure-transition lifting requires exact current ClayCode read/effect contract
effectful unresolved alternatives are proposals only and never multi-branch external executions
downtime cannot synthesize unpersisted cognitive branch evolution
payload/storage dedup does not imply epistemic/provenance merge
novelty_decision: No equivalent search supports a mechanism-novelty claim. Preserve only project-specific composition language and benchmark-derived implementation obligations.
